business_problem: FathomX needed secure, compliant cloud compute and storage to train, validate, and deploy mammogram-analysis models at scale while controlling infrastructure costs and supporting regional expansion across Asian healthcare markets.
solution_summary: FathomX built its breast-cancer detection platform on Alibaba Cloud GPU-powered infrastructure so the team could train and deploy AI models for mammogram analysis without maintaining fixed on-premises capacity. Elastic GPU Service supplies the parallel processing power needed to iterate over large imaging datasets and refine detection accuracy through repeated training cycles, while Elastic Compute Service provides the surrounding application runtime and secure deployment environment for the company's software-as-a-medical-device workflow. After training and validation, the models are integrated into a computer-aided detection and diagnosis system used by radiology teams. Alibaba Cloud's regional footprint across Asia lets FathomX develop and deploy close to local customers, and the provider's healthcare-oriented compliance posture helps the company protect sensitive imaging data while scaling into new regulated markets.
business_outcome: FathomX reduced lead times for computational resources, lowered annual infrastructure costs by 27.6%, and gained a scalable platform for deploying AI-driven breast cancer diagnostics in multiple Asian markets.
